name: artifact-preview
purpose: A card for something the assistant generated — a file, a code snippet, a table, a configuration (Cloudscape artifact previews, AI Elements Artifact). The header names it (title, description, metadata such as size or format, a file-type icon) and carries its actions: Copy (when `copyValue` is set), Download (when `downloadHref` is set) and Open (when `openable`, emitting `open` so the owner shows the full artifact in a side panel — Cloudscape's canvas preview). The body holds a short inline preview (Cloudscape's inline preview): the first lines of code, the first rows of a table.
useWhen: The assistant produced an artifact the reader may copy, download or open: a rules file, a CSV export, a command, a generated function.
avoidWhen: Short code inside the prose of a response → fenced code in `StreamingResponse` (rendered as `CodeBlock`).
A resource that already exists in the product → link to its page; this card is for generated content.
Uploads the reader attached → `file-dropzone` items or chips in `PromptInput`'s attachments.
related: code-block` — the usual inline preview body.
drawer` — where an `open` artifact is shown in full.
chat-message` — artifacts stack under the response, not inside its bubble.
bestPractices: Stack artifacts below the message text, one card each; do not nest them in the bubble.
Keep artifact actions in the card and message actions in `ChatMessage.Actions`.
Express sizes in KB, MB or GB in `meta`.
Long or editable content opens (canvas); the inline body stays a preview.

props.name: title
props.doc: File name or title of what was generated (`cache-rules.json`).

props.name: description
props.doc: One line on what it is or does.

props.name: meta
props.doc: Facts that help recognize it: size, rows, language (`2.4 KB · JSON`).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon class for the file type.

props.name: copyValue
props.doc: Text the Copy control puts on the clipboard. Empty hides Copy.

props.name: downloadHref
props.doc: URL of the file for the Download control. Empty hides Download.

props.name: openable
props.doc: Shows Open, which emits `open` so the owner shows the full artifact in a side panel or page (a canvas preview).

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The inline preview; scrolls inside a 20 rem body.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Extra icon actions, placed before Copy and Download.
